notes.title: Achievements, Localization, and Music... oh my!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We’ve had some excellent feedback from players since our launch earlier this year (thank you!) and are excited to be bringing some of the requested features in our latest update. 

George will be dancing along (can cloth swatches dance? Scooting maybe? Anyway,) to some new music as 12 new tracks have been added, each with their own variation for 25 new pieces of music. Along with new music, we’ve given the game’s SFX a fresh patch so every split at the seam, thimble full of steam, or laser beam will have a fancy new or enhanced sound (the lasers are extra sizzly).

Whether it’s your first time or fifth time helping George find Samantha, you’ll want to collect those achievements or, as we like to call them iron-on patches. Seven brand new hand-embroidered patches err, achievements are yours to pin to your denim jacket as you guide George through the perils of puzzles.

Alongside new music and achievements, we’re pleased to be adding the following languages to George’s storybook:
-Spanish (Latam)
-German
-Russian
-Japanese
-Chinese (simplified Mandarin)

We’re incredibly grateful for the support and feedback we’ve received since launch. If you ever encounter issues within the game, please connect with us through our Discussions panel or our Discord here: https://discord.gg/7SVmFaSE9U so that we can remedy them as quickly as possible. If you enjoy George’s tactile world and figuring out Where’s Samantha? We always appreciate reviews. If you’re a curator or press interested in reviewing the game, please connect with us!
